Broker Opinion of Value   ·   Confidential
38 RANDOLPH AVE
JERSEY CITY, NJ 07305 · BERGEN-LAFAYETTE

This Broker Opinion of Value provides GRID's independent assessment of market pricing for 38 Randolph Ave, a 6-unit multifamily asset in Jersey City's Bergen-Lafayette neighborhood. The building was fully renovated eight years ago with a roof replacement four years ago, and every unit is individually metered for utilities — a turnkey ownership profile with minimal near-term capital exposure. In-place rents across the two- and three-bedroom unit mix sit meaningfully below current market levels: pushing rents to an estimated $2,100 (2BR) and $2,300 (3BR) through VCI updates can provide a meaningful lift — gross income up roughly 15%. At in-place NOI the asset already clears conventional lender minimums across a wide range of pricing and leverage scenarios, giving buyers a financeable deal today while retaining embedded upside as leases turn.

Debt Service Coverage   ·   Stress Test Matrix

DSCR calculated on in-place NOI of $95,369 across each pricing scenario and a 65%–75% loan-to-value range at prevailing commercial multifamily rates. A DSCR below 1.20x is typically insufficient for conventional financing; lenders generally require 1.25x or better. Market NOI (~$115,565 stabilized) materially improves all scenarios.

Assumes 30-year amortization, interest-only periods not modeled. Rates reflect current commercial/agency multifamily pricing (6.00%–6.75%) as of Q3 2026. At in-place NOI, the Base and Conservative scenarios clear the 1.25x lender minimum across the full 65%–75% LTV range; the Opportunistic price stays financeable through 70% leverage and tightens toward 75%. At stabilized market NOI (~$115,565), coverage improves by roughly 21% across all scenarios. Buyer to confirm current rate environment with their lender. All figures are estimates only.
